capture-stamp.py contents (reproducible with the command above):
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile

from astrid.core._shared.boot_manifest import stamp_boot_manifest
if sys.argv[2] == 'r9':
    from astrid.packs.shots.conformance import VIBE_PROFILE_REGISTRY, vibe_profile_specs
else:
    from astrid.core.gateway.boot_conformance import VIBE_PROFILE_REGISTRY, vibe_profile_specs

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    support = Path(directory)
    path = support / 'astrid-host' / 'boot-manifest.json'
    stamp_boot_manifest(path, support_root=support,
                        registry=VIBE_PROFILE_REGISTRY, fixtures=vibe_profile_specs())
    Path(sys.argv[1]).write_bytes(path.read_bytes())

Observation: R9 and R12 stamps are byte-identical, both with profile_order
["pip_embedded", "checkout_server"]. Both need restamping for R13's empty registry.
